name: Tuning panel
what: A side panel of live sliders, switches, choices and colours for every feel number in the game, with the game's own value beside each, changed values marked in gold, reset per value, per group or all, search, folding groups, A/B/C slots to compare feels, presets with descriptions, a plain-words short list, freeze and frame step, values kept across reloads, and a one-click hand-back to the agent: Save for my agent (writes src/tuning.json) or Copy changes (a header line plus compact JSON). A drop-in upgrade for the kit starter's own panel.
use_when: a person will tune the game's feel by playing it and should hand the exact numbers back to the agent instead of describing them
from_game: TUMEN, Hezarfen, Inkbound, Scrapfall, Still Life 2
good_for: Any game where feel matters and a person plays between agent rounds: movement, jumps, camera, hit-stop, difficulty, colours. Replaces the starter's panel with the same tuning.json and save endpoint; also works in any page with or without three.js.
not_for: Settings menus for players (it is a developer tool, English only, shown on the dev server and ?test=1 pages); values that need a reload to apply (it changes them live).
how_to_add: node tools/blocks/add.mjs meticulai-tuning-panel, then replace my-game/src/core/settings.js with the three lines in HOW-TO-USE.md
